comparison.objective: Tension, pluck and release a chalk line to make one straight mark; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual tension maintenance and controlled transverse release versus fine screw/collar manipulation and feedback-based tuning.
comparison.success_condition: One print must pass close to the mark with limited bow and the reel returned; candidate passes on repeated dynamic carriage behavior within mechanical limits.
comparison.reason: Dynamic release and force control are generic similarities, but the measured ability and outcome are materially different.
